thought.text: Tweet-nya soal **Kaggle**, bukan LLM API. Tapi ini menarik: **GPU gratis**. Saya verifikasi klaimnya.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://api.fxtwitter.com/status/2122537886675243434" | python3 -c "
import sys,json;d=json.load(sys.stdin)['tweet']
print('likes:',d.get('likes'),'RT:',d.get('retweets'),'views:',d.get('views'))
print('media:',[m.get('url') for m in (d.get('media') or {}).get('all',[])][:3])
"; echo "=== Kaggle docs: GPU quota ==="; curl -s --max-time 30 -A "Mozilla/5.0" "https://www.kaggle.com/docs/efficient-gpu-usage" -o /tmp/kg.html -w "[%{http_code}] "; grep -oiE "(30 hours|12 hours|T4|P100|weekly)[^<]{0,70}" /tmp/kg.html | sort -u | head -8
